_doc: E1 (mason-2) building interface. Blender space, metres: X right along the facade, Y into the building (street is -Y), Z up. X=0 the arch axis (keystone head / marquee centre), Z=0 street level at the facade, Y=0 the main facade wall plane. Front numbers measured off the bible through aa_bible_cam (scale anchored on the 4.4 m doorway); roof, right corner and right side from the asset sheet (crops 12/14). 'opening' = the hole in the stone = the inner edge of the bible's stone surround. 'frame_bible' = the dark frame's outer edge as the bible draws it, traced on the face plane y=0. 'frame_at_reveal' = the same outline moved back along aa_bible_cam's rays to the frame's front plane (y = reveal_depth): build the frame to frame_at_reveal and the bible camera sees frame_bible exactly. Source of truth: tools/content_generation/absinthe_arcade/manifest.json -> facade; this file is written by publish_interfaces.py.
status: v2 (2026-10-28): building depth 4.0 (Q-011), side elevation, interior volume, jambs, keystone recess, window linings and reveals bible-checked. Stable.
changes_v2: building: depth 4.0 m; side elevation, roof footprint, side openings and side dormer published (Q-011).
interior: interior_depth / set_depth 3.40 from the door line y=0.34 to y=3.74; back wall inner face y=3.76 (back wall 0.24).
arch: right jamb 2.20 -> 2.37 (bible pier arris 2.375, neon's doorway edge 2.365); left jamb -2.30; ring intrados half 2.30 about X=0 (axis unchanged); right pier 2.37..2.80.
keystone: aa_arch_hero_cartouche removed; no crown voussoir (|x|<0.27); E4's head and volutes sit in front of the archivolt.

windows: openings unchanged from v1.1 except L1 (elliptical head, crown 4.876); frames per glazier (L1 1.06, L3 0.98, frame_bible.x_right added for L3); reveal 0.20 -> 0.08 for every front and side window (bible check); frame_at_reveal added.
dormers: frame, lining and reveal added (glazier); side dormer added.

v2.1: L1 frame re-traced in the bible: 1.005 wide (-3.845..-2.84), not glazier's 1.06 (11 px wide on each side), so its 0.08 reveal fits without clamping; corner bay cornices refitted to the bible (ground 0.18 proud, band 7.65-7.9, mid 9.45-9.7 at 0.25) and cant windows moved between them (8.0-9.25, 9.95-11.2). The wall face, arch and openings are unchanged from v2.0.

facade.note: x_left_corner = main wall's left arris where it turns into the angled corner bay; x_right_seam = the right corner (outer edge of the right downpipe).

building.note: Q-011 (author): about 4.0 m deep, the asset sheet's one-bay right side. Footprint CCW from the front-left arris; the corner bay's cant runs from (x_left, 0) to its far end.

placeholder_backstop.note: E1's dark backstop; hide or delete it when E3's interior set is integrated

interior.note: Q-011: the interior behind the doors fits within about 3.4 m. Measured from E3's door line (y 0.34) to y 3.74, 0.02 short of the back wall.

storeys.note: Stone ledge lines in the bible's left column (5.9 under the cat-window apron, 10.0 under the balcony slab); the right column sits 0.36-0.47 m lower. Above the eave cornice: the slate mansard (Q-001).

windows_note: Bible check (v2, through aa_bible_cam): the openings match the inner edge of the stone surround on L1, L2, L3 and R1 (traced); the frames match glazier's widths. The light band between frame and surround is the lining (lining.sides), not a narrower opening, so the openings stay. Reveal 0.08: at 0.20 the frames of the left column would sit 37-44 px right and 23-47 px lower in the bible camera than the bible draws them (R column up to 62 px lower).

keystone.note: The bible shows no cartouche: the carved head (E4, keystone_head_bible) and its volutes sit IN FRONT of the archivolt. E1 removed aa_arch_hero_cartouche and builds no voussoir at the crown; the wall face (with the mural) shows behind the head. E4 no longer needs its recess_keystone_context().

arch.note: v2: the bible's right pier inner arris traces at X=2.375 (rows z 1.2-2.5, plane y=-0.15, std 0.002) and neon's doorway right edge at 2.365, so the right jamb moves to 2.37. The archivolt still springs at +-2.30 about X=0 (its intrados lands at 2.25-2.30 on both sides in the bible): the arch axis does NOT move; the right impost covers the 0.07 shelf. Left jamb stays -2.30 (conduits cover it; the doorway's left frame edge is -2.02).

right_corner.note: Asset sheet crops 12/14: the facade ends against the right downpipe; pilaster+capital and quoins wrap the corner onto the side elevation.

frame.u_axis: world +Y (u=0 the front face, u=4.0 the back corner)

framed_panel.note: the sheet's framed dark board below the ground-floor window (E6 dresses it)

front_corner.note: the right downpipe on the corner (E4/E6)

front_corner_lantern.note: the sheet's side shows the facade's right lantern (aa_prop_wall_lantern, x 2.93, z 3.7) on the front corner: same lantern, no second one (E6)

side_right.flower_boxes: one per window, on the sill slab (E2)
side_right.note: Right side elevation (Q-011 answer A: exactly the asset sheet's one-bay side, crops 14/11; depth 4.0 m). Local frame of the side face: u = world Y (0 at the front face, 4.0 at the back), v into the building (world -X), face at world X = x_right (3.04). Windows share R1/R2's floors; positions along u are the sheet's proportions; the ground-floor composition is the sheet's, scaled into the right ground storey (0..5.48). v2: side windows use R1/R2's bible opening and frame (0.94 hole, 0.76 frame): the sheet draws every window squatter than the bible (its R1 frame is 0.65 w/h, the bible's 0.40), so the bible's R1 proportions carry round the corner.

dormers.note: Mansard dormers from the asset sheet (crops 09/14): front pair over the window columns, one on the right side. Openings cut through the dormer fronts; frame/lining/reveal per glazier (E2).

chimneys.where: behind and right of the right dormer (the bible's asymmetric bays leave no room between the gable and the dormer)

roof.note: Asset sheet roof (crops 09, 10, 12, 13), rework 2026-10-29: bell-cast slate mansard (lower slope 13.55-15.35, upper slope to 15.70), the tall stone gable with C-scroll shoulders and an arched crown, four stone stacks with clay pots (crop 09 front: one behind each dormer, one either side of the gable; crop 10 is a close-up showing two of them, crop 13 shows three with the fourth behind the gable), dormer bodies after E2's stand-in, iron cresting round the ridge, gapped behind the gable.

corner_bay.note: v2 (bible-fitted through aa_bible_cam): the 45-degree cant holds (the bay's cornice edges run at the cant's image slope, -2.5..-3.7). Cornices refitted to the bible's corner points: ground-floor 5.6-5.95 proud 0.18 (mitre corner at bible px 1310,1910), a band at 7.65-7.9 proud 0.2, the mid cornice 9.45-9.7 proud 0.25 (corner at 1385,680), eave 13.2-13.55. The cant windows sit between them.

clocktower_plaza_sign_mount_zone.note: E6 hangs the CLOCKTOWER PLAZA bracket sign here (Q-006: ruled IN), on the Arcade's left corner
